acquisition.label: Connection
acquisition.help: Saved Connection profile — it carries the connector type (SFTP, Azure Blob, Kafka, Database).

acquisition.label: Include patterns
acquisition.help: Glob/regex discovery patterns; comma-separate multiple. Blank = the pipeline file pattern.

acquisition.label: Duplicate detection
acquisition.help: File-level duplicate policy — how a re-seen file is recognised.

acquisition.label: On changed duplicate
acquisition.help: What to do when a known file re-appears changed.

acquisition.label: Stability window
acquisition.help: Wait for a file to stop growing before collecting it.

acquisition.label: Archive path
acquisition.help: Target directory when "After success" is Move.

transform.filter.label: Row predicate (after parsing)
transform.filter.help: SQL over the mapped, typed columns. Rows matching are kept; NULL results are dropped.

transform.filter.label: Include matching (before parsing)
transform.filter.help: Keep rows whose target column matches any of these regexes, checked on the raw text before parsing.

transform.filter.label: Exclude matching (before parsing)
transform.filter.help: Drop rows whose target column matches any of these regexes.

transform.filter.label: Include by prefix (before parsing)
transform.filter.help: Keep rows whose target column starts with any of these.

transform.filter.label: Exclude by prefix (before parsing)
transform.filter.help: Drop rows whose target column starts with any of these.

transform.filter.label: Target column index
transform.filter.help: Which raw column (0-based) the four before-parsing lists above match against. Ignored by the row predicate.

transform.route.label: Route mode
transform.route.help: Named routes and their predicates are edited on the canvas edges.

sink.persistent.label: Database directory
sink.persistent.help: Directory where committed batches land. The pipeline's primary sink must set this; a quarantine sink writes unmatched files to 'dir' instead.

sink.persistent.label: Output format
sink.persistent.help: Stage-1 output file format; absent = CSV (the engine default).

sink.persistent.label: Compression
sink.persistent.help: Codec for the output (e.g. snappy / zstd / gzip); blank = format default.

sink.materialized.label: Output format
sink.materialized.help: Stage-1 output file format; absent = CSV (the engine default).

sink.materialized.label: Compression
sink.materialized.help: Codec for the output (e.g. snappy / zstd / gzip); blank = format default.

sink.view.label: Output format
sink.view.help: Stage-1 output file format; absent = CSV (the engine default).

sink.view.label: Compression
sink.view.help: Codec for the output (e.g. snappy / zstd / gzip); blank = format default.
